summary: Implemented direct FP32 stores for deterministic persistent router GEMM and aten::mm.dtype, routed FP32 requests away from BF16-only DeepGEMM, and made the deterministic DeepSeek gate request FP32 through one persistent path for every token count. Verified the ROCm Triton kernel on an MI350X against an independent CPU FP64 reference and with near-tied expert scores.

tests.what_was_measured: 11 tests and 54 subtests passed on GPU, covering direct FP32 accumulator storage through aten::mm.dtype, the deterministic DeepSeek gate branch, independent CPU FP64 comparison, near-tied expert ordering, repeatability, sub-batch invariance, and forced bypass of the BF16-only DeepGEMM entry point.
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, and registered-test metadata checks all passed.

tests.command: SGLANG_BATCH_INVARIANT_OPS_ENABLE_MM_DEEPGEMM=0 ... numerical router-shape probe for M=(1,4,5,16,17), K=7168, N=256
tests.what_was_measured: MI350X FP32 output had max absolute error 0.00030517578125 versus CPU FP64 rounded to FP32, compared with 0.966156005859375 after BF16 rounding; 4351/4352 values retained non-BF16 precision, repeated output was bitwise equal, and every tested sub-batch was bitwise equal to the corresponding full-batch rows.

tests.command: SGLANG_BATCH_INVARIANT_OPS_ENABLE_MM_DEEPGEMM=0 ... MoEGate deterministic forward probe for M=(1,4,5,16,17), K=7168, N=256
tests.what_was_measured: The actual deterministic MoEGate branch returned torch.float32, retained non-BF16 values, was repeatable, and was bitwise invariant across all tested token counts.

tests.command: Inspect Triton cache TTGIR generated by the GPU tests under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c3ca3fa17f2b/cache/triton
tests.what_was_measured: The FP32 specialization stores tensor<128x128xf32> directly from the accumulator; the BF16 specialization stores tensor<128x128xbf16>. Both target gfx950 and retain BF16 inputs and the same MFMA instruction shape.

gpu_execution_evidence: Executed the persistent Triton kernel and deterministic MoEGate branch on AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) using Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Detailed output is retained in reports/j-c3ca3fa17f2b/evidence.md.
remaining_limitations: CUDA persistent-kernel execution was not verified because the assigned GPU is AMD gfx950.

DeepGEMM execution was not verified because its CUDA-only BF16 GEMM path is unavailable on this ROCm host; a unit regression verifies that FP32 requests bypass it rather than widening rounded BF16 output.
No FlyDSL C++ source was changed and repository-environment.json provides no native rebuild artifact, so no native rebuild was required or performed.
The tiny Llama serving fixture was not used because this change is a DeepSeek router-kernel numerical contract and that fixture cannot qualify the architecture or numerical semantics.
